candidate_space.exhaustive_over: the five declared coordinates and their declared values, and nothing wider.  It does not enumerate an augmentation that changes the event grammar again, that admits more than one further mark in one step, that supplies a datum the caller never presented, or that derives the permitted renamings from the judgment grammar instead of declaring them (definition 16).  Every minimality statement below is scoped to this space

measures.mu1: capability count: the number of undeclared capabilities the candidate uses
measures.mu2: collateral count: how many of the five declared facts about the retained configuration the candidate makes internally available that the same reading's base did not. requirement.declared: the two retained marks are internally separable under a reading exactly when no permitted automorphism of the regime carries one of them to the other
requirement.readings_agree_because: membership in a mark's orbit under the permitted renamings is a property of a (regime, mark) pair invariant under those renamings by construction, and it separates the two marks exactly when no permitted automorphism carries one to the other; the agreement is therefore by unfolding, which is what makes the second reading a restatement of the first and not a further fact.  The receipt computes it at every point rather than asserting it
requirement.second_reading: some property of a mark that is invariant under every permitted renaming of the reading holds of one retained mark and not of the other

C2-X.every_minimum_clause_fact: the frozen clause reads 'every minimum one-step augmentation will either name a side, paying under U what reading O paid at genesis, or admit a further datum that the automorphism cannot carry', and its falsifier names 'a minimum that pays neither a side name nor a further datum'.  Two retained minima pay neither: withdrawing the side exchange admits no name, and withdrawing the mark permutations is neither.  The falsifier fired.  On the weaker reading that counts the withdrawal of the side exchange as paying what reading O paid, the clause still misses, on the second of those two
C2-X.evidence: the declared sense is the Challenge 2 notion; under O the requirement holds with no augmentation and the minimum count is zero; under U it fails; no candidate that only changes the judgment grammar satisfies it; and three non-isomorphic minima are retained, so uniqueness is refused
C2-X.label: NOT FORCED

C3-1.evidence: the declared sense agrees with the Challenge 2 notion at the base regime under both readings; the two readings of the requirement agree at all 48 points under each reading; and a satisfying candidate exists whose witness is the orbit property alone, no declared mark property being both invariant and separating there
C3-1.label: NOT FORCED
C3-1.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the sense is the run's declaration, and the agreement of its two readings is by unfolding, the orbit witness being invariant by construction; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content

C3-2.evidence: the O regime meets the requirement and the U regime does not; in all four cells under each reading the requirement is met exactly when the side exchange is not permitted, whether or not the names are admitted; and the O satisfaction is priced to the boundary, the withdrawal of the side exchange, and the occurrence identity, with the names recorded as not used
C3-2.label: FORCED
C3-2.result_basis: content on the side-exchange coordinate: whether an automorphism carries one retained mark to the other is a search over the unpruned enumeration, and both values are attained.  DEFINITION-level on the names coordinate: under definition 16 permission is declared and not derived from the judgment grammar, so the names cannot enter the computation, and the square exhibits that declaration's consequence rather than discovering it

C3-3.evidence: admitting the two names into the U tower leaves the requirement unmet; no point of the declared space that changes only the judgment grammar satisfies it; and neither mark form is invariant under the permitted renamings of the U base, which is why both separate the marks as raw data and neither does so internally
C3-3.label: FORCED
C3-3.result_basis: content: that no property invariant under the composite separates the two retained marks is the Lean no_invariant_mark_property_separates_retained, quantified over an arbitrary property and not by unfolding, and that neither mark form is invariant under it is the Lean countermodel mark_form_is_not_invariant_under_the_composite; the census of the declared space is a computation

C3-4.evidence: five coordinates and 48 points under each reading; a point is one step exactly when its capability count is one; every point of count two or more is refused as bundling; and the reading-O candidate has count two and is refused
C3-4.label: NOT FORCED
C3-4.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the coordinates, their values, the capability named for each, and therefore the point count and the identity of one-step with capability count one are declarations of this rung; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content

C3-5.evidence: exactly four one-step points satisfy the requirement under U, in three classes, the two further-mark points being one class; the minimum capability count is one; all three classes are retained and uniqueness is refused
C3-5.label: FORCED
C3-5.result_basis: content: which one-step points satisfy the requirement is a search over the unpruned enumeration at each candidate's own renamings, and the class count is the implemented quotient; the two further-mark points fall together because the side exchange carries one regime to the other, which is a witness search and not a declaration

C3-6.evidence: the collateral count is one at each of the three minima, so both measures select the same three classes at a minimum of one; and some point of the space has different values under the two measures, so neither measure is the other
C3-6.label: FORCED
C3-6.result_basis: content: each collateral fact is an isomorphism-witness or automorphism search at the candidate's own renamings, and that the two measures differ somewhere is a census over the 48 points

C3-7.evidence: withdrawing the side exchange makes both side properties invariant and separating and leaves the index properties non-invariant; withdrawing the mark permutations does the reverse, and satisfies the requirement by unfolding; admitting a further mark leaves none of the five both invariant and separating
C3-7.label: FORCED
C3-7.result_basis: content on the first and third mechanisms: the invariance of each declared mark property is a census over the bounded domain under the candidate's renamings, and the third minimum's empty row is what makes the orbit witness necessary.  DEFINITION-level on the second: with the mark permutations withdrawn no permitted renaming moves an index at all, so that candidate satisfies the requirement by unfolding, and the receipt reports that separately

C3-8.evidence: under O the minimum capability count is zero, attained by the null augmentation alone; under U it is one, attained by three classes; nothing new is paid under O at this rung and one capability is paid by the run under U
C3-8.label: NOT FORCED
C3-8.result_basis: content: the two minimum counts and the two class counts are the enumeration's results under each reading.  The boundary-dependence map beside them is the run's classification and is not computed

tally.criterion: a prediction counts as content only if at least one of its hitting clauses, read literally, rests on a theorem outside the DEFINITION-level lists of the paper's section 7 or on a computation not fixed by a declaration alone; a prediction whose every clause is true by unfolding a declaration, or reports a modelling decision of the run, is HIT by construction and not counted as content

what_the_challenge_exercises.admission: examined: the further-mark candidate is the first event in the run that the process rather than the caller would issue, and it is priced as one capability and admitted by no history the receipt certifies as current
what_the_challenge_exercises.current-state designation: unchanged: the current state is still the replay of the caller's Challenge 2 history; every candidate regime is the replay of an explicit candidate history and none is current
what_the_challenge_exercises.equality: yes: structural regime equality, the isomorphism relation at the reading's declared renamings, and the isomorphism relation at a candidate's declared renamings are three different relations, and the rung uses all three
what_the_challenge_exercises.mention: yes: the shared visible mark is named by every event of every candidate history and is not an identity
what_the_challenge_exercises.observation: yes: the two mark forms, and under a candidate the side-name form; no new form is needed and none is added to the closed grammar
what_the_challenge_exercises.retention: unchanged: the two retained marks and their judgments are those of Challenge 2, and they survive the further admission
what_the_challenge_exercises.side: yes: the side each retained mark lies on is what two of the three minima make internal, one by withdrawing the side exchange and one by making the two sides carry different numbers of marks
what_the_challenge_exercises.supply: no new one: the further-mark candidate admits the token the caller already presented, and a token never presented is refused by name
